render_help:
usage: registry.py render [-h]
                          {omniroute,litellm,ide,openhands,models-doc} ...

positional arguments:
  {omniroute,litellm,ide,openhands,models-doc}
    omniroute           render configuration/omniroute/combos.json
    litellm             render the AUTOOS-MANAGED tier blocks of
                        configuration/litellm/config.yaml
    ide                 render catalog/ide-models.json (opencode/OpenHands
                        model lists)
    openhands           render configuration/openhands/tier-profiles.json
    models-doc          render docs/models.md's AUTOOS-MANAGED models-doc
                        table

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
render_help.ide:
usage: registry.py render ide [-h] [--registry REGISTRY] [--out OUT] [--check]
                              [--ide-models IDE_MODELS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --registry REGISTRY   registry JSON to render from (default:
                        <autoos>/catalog/ai-registry.json)
  --out OUT             write the render here instead of stdout (to update the
                        committed file: --out catalog/ide-models.json)
  --check               exit 1 if the render differs semantically from --ide-
                        models
  --ide-models IDE_MODELS
                        today's ide-models.json to compare against, --check
                        only (default: <autoos>/catalog/ide-
                        models.json)
render_help.litellm:
usage: registry.py render litellm [-h] [--registry REGISTRY] [--config CONFIG]
                                  [--out OUT] [--check]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --registry REGISTRY  registry JSON to render from (default:
                       <autoos>/catalog/ai-registry.json)
  --config CONFIG      today's config.yaml to locate blocks in / compare
                       against (default:
                       <autoos>/configuration/litellm/config.yaml)
  --out OUT            write the render here instead of stdout (never the real
                       config.yaml)
  --check              exit 1 if a managed block differs byte-for-byte from
                       --config
render_help.models-doc:
usage: registry.py render models-doc [-h] [--registry REGISTRY] [--out OUT]
                                     [--check] [--docs DOCS]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --registry REGISTRY  registry JSON to render from (default:
                       <autoos>/catalog/ai-registry.json)
  --out OUT            write the render here instead of stdout (never the real
                       docs/models.md - there is no --write; paste the output
                       between the committed markers by hand, or --check to
                       confirm they already agree)
  --check              exit 1, naming each differing route row, if the render
                       differs from --docs's own models-doc block
  --docs DOCS          today's docs/models.md to compare against, --check only
                       (default: <autoos>/docs/models.md)
render_help.omniroute:
usage: registry.py render omniroute [-h] [--registry REGISTRY] [--out OUT]
                                    [--check] [--combos COMBOS]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --registry REGISTRY  registry JSON to render from (default:
                       <autoos>/catalog/ai-registry.json)
  --out OUT            write the render here instead of stdout (never the real
                       combos.json)
  --check              exit 1 if the render differs semantically from --combos
  --combos COMBOS      today's combos.json to compare against, --check only
                       (default: <autoos>/configuration/omniroute/c
                       ombos.json)
render_help.openhands:
usage: registry.py render openhands [-h] [--registry REGISTRY] [--out OUT]
                                    [--check] [--tier-profiles TIER_PROFILES]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --registry REGISTRY   registry JSON to render from (default:
                        <autoos>/catalog/ai-registry.json)
  --out OUT             write the render here instead of stdout (never the
                        real tier-profiles.json)
  --check               exit 1 if the render differs semantically from --tier-
                        profiles
  --tier-profiles TIER_PROFILES
                        today's tier-profiles.json to compare against, --check
                        only (default:
                        <autoos>/configuration/openhands/tier-
                        profiles.json)
